title: Courses & Community Lessons
changes: New Courses: structured, multi-lesson learning tracks with lessons that unlock as you progress
Built-in HSK 1 course to get started right away
Create your own courses from your lessons — private by default, publish when you're ready to share
Finish a course lesson to unlock the next one, with a celebration when you complete the whole course
New Community tab to browse, search, and filter lessons shared by other learners
Publish your lessons to the community with a title, description, level, and tags
Add any community lesson straight to your deck (duplicate cards are detected automatically)
New tabbed Learn hub to switch between My Lessons, Courses, and Community
"Continue learning" card on the home dashboard jumps you back into your active course
Reorder lessons when building a course and pick its difficulty level
Faster, more reliable interactive lesson generation
